name: Niko Kids Clinic
description: Niko Kids Clinic — a theme for a paediatric clinic (illness visits, vaccinations, check-ups and an allergy clinic), laid out as an editorial magazine under a formal white top header: the clinic name and tagline centred on top, a Book a visit button at the right and the menu as a centred row underneath (an aqua numbered overlay on phones). Byakugun pale aqua (#78C2C4) is the main colour, with a fine film-grain texture: the hero field, the story band, the visit-steps heading block and every page head are aqua fields in deep-teal type, with coral as a second risograph-style ink. The hero is a diagonal split: text on the aqua field, the waiting-room photograph cut on a diagonal with a coral misregistered edge, and a photo collage across the seam — a tilted print of toy blocks, a cut-out stethoscope and a cut-out teddy bear (transparent WebP) that breaks across the diagonal and past the hero bottom edge. Sections read like a magazine: running rules over every label, a numbered two-column care index with column rules, staggered visit steps and a lead story beside two side stories. Every picture is a realistic film-grain photograph (35mm look, 50mm f/2, natural side light). Noto Sans JP for display, Lato for reading, Noto Sans TC for Traditional Chinese headings. Sample content in English, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French and German; vertical labels only in Chinese and Japanese. WCAG AA colours; no entrance animations.
deviation: Illustration style risograph converted to a film-grain photo direction (35mm film look, 50mm f/2, natural side light, visible fine grain, slightly faded colours graded toward byakugun #78C2C4) per the 2026-10-18 photo rule for commercial themes; the risograph feel stays in the layout as a coral second ink with a misregistered diagonal edge and a grain texture on every aqua field. The collage is built from those photographs: a tilted print and two transparent cut-outs layered across the diagonal.

summary.zh-TW: 白群淡青色的小兒科診所：雜誌式版面、置中選單、斜切分割主視覺，照片拼貼與破框的去背泰迪熊、底片感寫實照片，含五種語言樣本。
summary.en: A pale aqua paediatric clinic: magazine layout, centred menu, diagonal hero with photo collage and cut-out teddy bear, film-grain photos.
summary.ja: 白群色の小児科クリニック。雑誌風レイアウト、中央寄せメニュー、斜め分割のヒーローに写真コラージュと枠を越えるテディベア、フィルム調写真。
summary.fr: Un cabinet pédiatrique bleu d’eau : mise en page magazine, menu centré, héros en diagonale avec collage photo et ourson détouré.
summary.de: Kinderarztpraxis in Hellaqua: Magazin-Layout, zentriertes Menü, diagonal geteilter Hero mit Fotocollage und freigestelltem Teddy.
